selection_protocol: 5-Fold Cross-Validation on 30 Dev+Internal screenshots (zero external leakage).

Education: a course, lecture, study, or learning screenshot
an online class or tutorial screenshot
Shopping: a product browsing or ecommerce screenshot
a shopping cart or store catalog screenshot
Payment: a payment, receipt, transaction, or financial screenshot
a banking, checkout, or money transfer screenshot
a payment confirmation or invoice screenshot
Coding: a programming or software development screenshot
a code editor or terminal screenshot
an IDE or code repository screenshot
Travel: a travel booking, itinerary, flight, or hotel screenshot
a map, navigation, or trip planning screenshot
Work & Career: a workplace, professional, job, or career screenshot
a resume, LinkedIn, or business document screenshot
Communication: a messaging, chat, email, or communication screenshot
a social media conversation or inbox screenshot
Entertainment: an entertainment, video, music, or media screenshot
a movie, streaming service, or gaming screenshot
Connectivity: a Wi-Fi, network, Bluetooth, or connectivity settings screenshot
a device settings or network connection screenshot
General: a miscellaneous phone or computer screen screenshot
